form.label: Control Readiness
form.description: Shared auditor and control-owner view for every selected framework.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_catalog.csv | lookup ccp_framework_selections framework_key OUTPUT selected | eval selected_value=tostring(coalesce(selected,default_selected)), selected=if(selected_value="1" OR selected_value="true",1,0) | search status=active selected=1 | fields framework_key framework_name
| inputlookup ccp_systems | search status=active | sort system_name | fields system_key system_name
| inputlookup ccp_scopes | search status=active | fields scope_key scope_name

div.p: Use this view to find what is ready for attestation, what needs evidence, and which checks require a document review or Splunk tracking result.

search.query: | `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_evidence_rollup` | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats sum(evidence_count) as evidence_count latest(expires_at) as expires_at latest(review_due_at) as review_due_at latest(reviewed_at) as reviewed_at latest(evidence_status) as evidence_status by framework_key requirement_key] | eval evidence_state=case(isnull(evidence_count) OR evidence_count=0,"No evidence",evidence_status="Expired","Expired",isnotnull(expires_at) AND strptime(expires_at,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")<now(),"Expired",isnotnull(review_due_at) AND strptime(review_due_at,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")<now(),"Review overdue",isnull(reviewed_at) OR reviewed_at="","Awaiting review",1=1,"Current") | stats count as Checks by evidence_state | rename evidence_state as "Evidence state" | sort "Evidence state"

| `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | search verification_mode="technical" OR verification_mode="hybrid" | lookup measurement_adapters.csv measurement_key OUTPUT adapter_key display_name adapter_type source freshness_window status as adapter_status | eval adapter_state=if(isnull(adapter_key),"Adapter needed",adapter_status) | stats count as Checks by adapter_state | rename adapter_state as "Adapter state" | sort "Adapter state"

| `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | stats count as checks dc(framework_key) as frameworks | eval summary=checks." checks across ".frameworks." selected framework(s)" | table summary

single.option: document, technical, and hybrid routes are shown below

search.query: | `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_evidence_rollup` | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats sum(evidence_count) as evidence_count by framework_key requirement_key] | eval evidence_count=coalesce(evidence_count,0) | stats count as checks sum(eval(if(evidence_count>0,1,0))) as with_evidence | eval summary=with_evidence." of ".checks." checks have evidence on record" | table summary checks with_evidence

single.option: evidence on record is not the same as validated evidence

search.query: | `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_latest_assessments` | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats latest(status) as status by framework_key requirement_key] | eval result_status=if(isnull(status),"Not assessed",status) | stats count as checks by result_status | eventstats sum(checks) as total_checks | eval passed=if(result_status="Pass",checks,0) | stats sum(passed) as passed max(total_checks) as checks | eval percent=round((passed/checks)*100,1) | table percent passed checks

single.option: only the latest recorded decision is counted

search.query: | `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_latest_assessments` | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats latest(status) as status by framework_key requirement_key] | eval result_status=if(isnull(status),"Not assessed",status) | search result_status="Not assessed" | stats count

| inputlookup ccp_findings | search status="Open" OR status="In progress" OR status="Risk accepted" | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats count

single.option: findings still require an owner decision or retest

search.query: | `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_latest_assessments` | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats latest(status) as status by framework_key requirement_key] | eval result_status=if(isnull(status),"Not assessed",status) | stats count by result_status | rename result_status as Status | sort Status

| `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_latest_assessments` | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats latest(reviewer) as reviewer latest(reviewed_at) as reviewed_at by framework_key requirement_key] | eval review_state=if(isnull(reviewed_at) OR reviewed_at="","Awaiting review","Reviewed") | stats count as Checks by review_state | rename review_state as "Review state" | sort "Review state"

| `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | stats count by verification_label verification_mode | rename verification_label as "How to prove it" verification_mode as Route count as Checks

| `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_latest_assessments` | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats latest(status) as status latest(score) as score latest(assessor) as assessor latest(assessed_at) as assessed_at latest(notes) as notes by framework_key requirement_key] | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_evidence_rollup` | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats sum(evidence_count) as evidence_count latest(last_evidence) as last_evidence by framework_key requirement_key] | eval result_status=if(isnull(status),"Not assessed",status), evidence_count=coalesce(evidence_count,0) | search NOT result_status="Pass" OR evidence_count=0 | lookup policy_playbook.csv framework_key requirement_key OUTPUT implementation_title owner_role common_gap | table framework_key framework_name requirement_key title verification_label verification_guidance result_status evidence_count last_evidence implementation_title owner_role common_gap | rename framework_name as Framework requirement_key as "Check key" title as Requirement verification_label as "How to prove it" verification_guidance as "Verification guidance" result_status as Status evidence_count as Evidence last_evidence as "Last evidence" implementation_title as "Implementation" owner_role as "Suggested owner" common_gap as "Common gap"

html.div: Pass is a decision, not a data point. Mark a check Pass only when the implementation is operating, the validation method has been executed, the evidence is current, and exceptions are resolved or formally accepted.
